Kasikorn Securities · ## BAY — 260721_Earnings_Review_BAY_E_SA_7P__300dfe78 --- page 1 --- July 21, 2026 8:05 AM 1 of 7 Bank of Ayudhya PCL Investment Topics ► 2Q26 earnings slightly below expectation. BAY reported 2Q26 earnings of Bt8.29bn, down 4% QoQ and flat YoY. The result was 3% below our expectation and 6% below Bloomberg consensus. The slight QoQ decline was driven mainly by an 11% QoQ drop in bad debt recoveries to Bt2.43bn in 2Q26. Although PPOP increased by 9% YoY, earnings were flat YoY as an 18bps YoY increase in credit cost offset the improvement in operating profit. Gross loans grew by 2% QoQ, driven mainly by Thai corporate lending, while growth in other loan segments remained subdued. Overall, 1H26 earnings accounted for 50% of our full-year 2026 forecast, suggesting that our current earnings projection is achievable. ► NPL sales help lower NPL ratio. BAY reported a 2Q26 NPL ratio of 3.5%, vs 4.1% in 1Q26. The drop in NPLs came mainly from the sale of NPLs of Bt3.65bn. 2Q26 credit cost was largely flat from 1Q26 at 2.37% while loan loss coverage ratio improved slightly to 135%. Stage 2 loans rose slightly to 9.7% from 9.6% in 1Q26. ► Expect stable 2H26 earnings HoH. We expect NII to resume HoH growth and credit cost to ease from 1H26 levels. However, we forecast earnings to remain broadly flat HoH, as net fee income is likely to decline from a high base in 1H26. Reported 2H26 earnings will also be distorted by the full-quarter deconsolidation of Home Credit Indonesia (HCID) from 3Q26, while the acquisition of the CIMB portfolio should support loan growth in 4Q26. Valuation and Recommendation ► Due to the limited upside to our target price, we downgrade BAY to Neutral with an unchanged target price of Bt47.5.
